headlines.title: Kennedy Center board votes to add president’s name again — and throw in a ‘Trump Plaza’
headlines.description: The Trump-appointed Kennedy Center board on Thursday voted to partially close the iconic arts center for up to two years during renovations and to re-add President Donald Trump’s name to the building’s facade, according to one person who attended the virtual board meeting and a second person familiar with the meeting.

headlines.title: Appeals court dodges major ruling on Trump’s contentious use of obscure deportation law
headlines.description: The case focuses on last year’s attempted removal of alleged Tren de Aragua gang members using the 18th century Alien Enemies Act.

headlines.title: The Constitution at a standstill: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, NBC News reporters dig into the impact of the Iran war on the economy at home and also on U.S. forces deployed in the region.

headlines.title: Peggy Flanagan welcomes Chuck Schumer on the campaign trail but says ‘it is time for new leadership’
headlines.description: Minnesota Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan (D), the Democratic nominee for Senate, joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss her primary win on Tuesday and her upcoming general election against Republican nominee Michele Tafoya.

headlines.title: Wisconsin Democrat David Crowley calls for ‘big tent’ after narrowly beating Francesca Hong
headlines.description: Wisconsin Democratic gubernatorial nominee David Crowley joins Meet the Press NOW after narrowly winning Tuesday’s primary to discuss his vision for uniting Wisconsin Democrats ahead of the general election and his views on data center development.

headlines.title: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt to Step Down
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is announcing Karoline Leavitt will be departing as White House Press Secretary at the end of August after more than a year and half on the job. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Haitians in Ohio who lost protected status get ankle monitors instead of ICE detention
headlines.description: Haitians living in Ohio who’ve lost their protected status are increasingly getting ankle monitors instead of being detained by immigration officers, attorneys say.

headlines.title: Judge dismisses Trump admin lawsuit alleging Harvard failed to protect Jewish students
headlines.description: A federal judge dismissed a lawsuit Thursday by the Trump administration ‌that alleged that Harvard University failed to protect Jewish and Israeli students from harassment.

headlines.title: 3 takeaways from David Crowley’s comeback: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt to step down
headlines.description: Leavitt, 28, is the youngest person to serve in the role. She will leave the Trump administration at the end of the month.

headlines.title: Extremism expert charged in case on Southern Poverty Law Center informants
headlines.description: “A free and fair society does not use the justice system to silence its political opponents,” Heidi Beirich’s attorney said in a statement.
